capture.title: Offer to save passwords
capture.why: To notice a new or changed password, Ferret has to run a small script on every https page, and so it asks the browser for access to https pages. The script changes nothing on a page and sends nothing until you submit a form with a password in it. What you typed is kept only in the memory of Ferret's background page, for at most five minutes, and is dropped when the vault locks. Nothing is saved without your click on the offer. Ferret never asks for your master password inside a web page.
